scope: S014 only; 600722.SH; 2020-01-01 through 2026-10-15; stage-two ETF risk information test; no platform/registry/account writes
authorization: ETF和期权的检验授权你一次性完成，我看结果
question: Does previously observable broad-market ETF unit redemption contain H3 loss-risk information beyond stock, broad-market, industry prices and the ETF own price change?

fixed_product.name: 华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF
fixed_product.selection_reason: Fixed in EX038 before this outcome test; long-listed domestic broad-market fund; not selected by 600722 subsequent returns. No cross-ETF product search. Not a claim that this ETF held 600722 historically.

timing_and_variable.P: second SSE open session strictly before T (T-2), obtained from pinned SSE calendar, never from preceding observed share row
timing_and_variable.main: z=1[TotalShare(P)/TotalShare(Q)-1 < 0], strictly negative; exact zero is z=0; missing/nonpositive/unknown adjustment is missing, never zero
timing_and_variable.economic_direction: z=1 is predeclared to increase subsequent H3 downside loss; do not reverse the story to contrarian bullish after results
timing_and_variable.units: total_share native 万份; ratio is dimensionless. Do not use total_size growth as cash flow, or fund_adj price adjustment as share adjustment
timing_and_variable.availability: Require both share records AvailableDate <= T under public temporal contract; preserve source/availability fields. EX038 documents previous-day data normally next morning and batched; T-2 lag adds one full session. Historical actual first-publish times and revisions remain unverified unless separately evidenced. Lag is an explicit research assumption, not PIT certification.
timing_and_variable.falsification_lag: z_late=1[TotalShare(Q)/TotalShare(R)-1 < 0] is the sole additional lag; only conservative timing sensitivity, never a replacement winner

price_controls.base: 65 locked EX032 stock/market/sector current and lagged main controls
price_controls.source: native close in ETF_SHARE_SIZE if publicly returned; fields verified before fitting; these are same-date ETF price controls, not extra signals
price_controls.event_rule: For price-control windows crossing a confirmed cash-dividend ex-date, mark event and exclude from common primary rows (raw close dividend drop is not price news); do not fit a price-adjusted proxy without verified source. Split/merge/conversion affecting any share interval makes that feature missing. Complete issuer/venue event evidence, not just a large-jump heuristic, is required to call the change net redemption.
price_controls.if_native_close_absent: Report source contract gap; do not silently replace with NAV or total_size/share, and do not use different rows per model. Parent may lock an explicit ETF_UNADJUSTED_DAILY request before outcomes.

outcome.existing_Y3: EX032 inputs.Y3 equals inherited H3 net_return exactly, already includes 10bp per side, fixed 1% LimitBuyHold entry, third-session planned exit with actual constraints; verify immutable execution reference before reuse
outcome.risk_target: L=max(-Y3,0). This is one predeclared deterministic loss transform of the existing return label, not a newly replayed entry/exit or new account.
outcome.parent: A == true: original low-open positive-close opportunity, all environments
outcome.unfilled: Keep inherited unfilled attempts in parent denominator and L=0 only when inherited net_return is certified zero. Separately report attempted, filled, CLOSED, pending/censored and excluded counts.
outcome.censored: Missing Y3 or actual maturity < 0 excluded from measured outcomes, never filled with zero; report final-window censoring and exclude from training until actual exit matured

models.M0: standardized ridge alpha=10: B65 plus the two ETF price controls -> L
models.M1: same estimator, training and evaluation rows as M0; add z only -> L
models.M1_late: same estimator/rows and B65+ETF prices; add z_late instead of z; timing falsification only
models.standardization: Train-only means/std ddof=0, constant scale<1e-12 -> 1, target unpenalized intercept. Formula reuse EX032 study.fit_one with y changed only to fixed L; no hyperparameter tuning and no prediction clipping.
models.training: As EX032, all eligible daily H3 attempt rows, not A-only; report transport to A explicitly. In each year, only rows with actual exit maturity strictly before first common full-feature evaluation signal in that year.
models.common_rows: Require B65, both ETF price controls, z and z_late finite, exact source calendar mapping, confirmed event validity and Y3/maturity validity. Freeze exclusion manifest before fitting; same rows across all models. Empty/one-state evaluation cells are NOT_ESTIMABLE.

primary_evaluation.forecast_increment: On A OOS rows: mean((L-pred_M0)^2-(L-pred_M1)^2); positive means added share state improves loss prediction. Give pooled, each year, and excluding 2026; paired cluster uncertainty.
primary_evaluation.mechanism: E[L-pred_M0 | z=1,A] - E[L-pred_M0 | z=0,A]; positive is predeclared risk direction after price controls. Give raw L difference, counts and training-fold z coefficients. Residual contrast is association, not causal effect.
primary_evaluation.use_diagnostic: Fixed upper training quartile of predicted loss defines reject for each model. Report mean_A((keep_M1-keep_M0)*Y3), downside avoided, positive-return opportunity cost, rejected fraction, kept mean and all-A outcome. No real account and no strategy eligibility claim.
primary_evaluation.participation_countercontrol: Within each evaluation year match M0 retained count to M1 exactly by M0 risk ordering; signal index is deterministic tie-break. Diagnostic uses feature scores/count only, not Y3; compare net allocation and downside to rule out apparent benefit from keeping fewer opportunities.

necessary_counterevidence: M1 must be compared with M0 containing same-date own-ETF returns and B65. Raw z-loss association alone cannot establish independent information.
M1_late is fixed additional delay. Show primary and late results side by side, never replace primary or search lags.
Per-year, without 2026, filled-only and all-attempt views; do not reinterpret unfilled zero as no market risk.

Form connected holding-overlap clusters by actual entry..maturity inclusive; unfilled attempts singleton. Use EX032 holding_diagnostics, equal-cluster weighting, leave-one-cluster-out, chronological nonoverlap and largest-contribution removal.
Cluster bootstrap paired metrics with fixed seed 13 and 2000 replicates; keep identical sampled clusters for both models; interval is exploratory under repeated S014 exposure.

Cash dividend/ex-date flags and split/merge evidence checked before outcomes; cannot choose event exclusions after seeing improvement. Known event exclusions and any uncertified event coverage remain visible.
If z is constant or empty in a fold, show NOT_ESTIMABLE for mechanism contrast and do not invent additional products, windows or signs. Model-identical behavior is valid negative evidence.
All S014 development history is already exposed; annual held-out predictions are development OOS, not a pristine independent confirmation.

budget.breakdown: 4 annual folds x (M0,M1,M1_late); 8 primary fits + 4 timing falsification fits
budget.provider_request_limit: ETF_SHARE_SIZE one 2020-2026 symbol range is <5000 expected sessions, but actual transport/ancillary calls must be counted from available receipt; never equate one prepare with one HTTP request. No automatic refresh/retry or channel switch.
budget.numeric_data_extension: Only fixed ETF_SHARE_SIZE 510300.SH within approved window; no constituents, real-time or alternative-product scans
budget.parallelism: At most 2 independent process workers, native BLAS threads=1; inherited deterministic ridge slots may be tiny, but resource choice must be explicit; no nested parallelism

formal_data_route.route: ctx=create_research_context(RepositoryContext.discover(ROOT), ResearchBatchRef('S014'), providers=approved_provider); prep=ctx.data.prepare((DataRequest(Dataset.ETF_SHARE_SIZE, '510300.SH', '2020-01-01', '2026-10-15', '2026-10-15'),), policy=PreparePolicy.REUSE); require prep.ready and persist prep.reference; fetched=ctx.data.fetch(request, prepared=prep.reference); require fetched.ready; retain identity/content hash/temporal metadata and raw dataframe as EvidenceRef via public API
formal_data_route.reference_note: EX038 MCP receipts are capability snapshots, not a full-window PreparedDataRef. New formal prepare is required. Do not fabricate a prepared reference from MCP content.
formal_data_route.coverage: For the long-listed fixed product compare all expected SSE sessions and actual dates; unique symbol/date, no missing/unexpected dates, finite positive shares/close; explicitly list missing source dates. Non-OHLCV READY alone may not certify full daily universe or first-publish times. Do not forward-fill across gaps.
formal_data_route.share_event_evidence: Issuer/venue dated split, reverse split, conversion, share-class/unit-basis changes and cash-distribution ex-date history over full used window. Record effective dates and ratios/none-found coverage scope before fitting. Do not infer no split merely from stable NAV or absence of huge share jumps; fund_adj merges price adjustments and cannot isolate share conversion.
formal_data_route.listing_survivorship: EX038 fixed identity says listed 2012-05-28. This is a chosen long-lived product test; it cannot generalize to historical ETF universe or infer 600722 ownership from current PCF. No listing-date extrapolation from newly listed small-cap ETFs.

decision_interpretation.supported: Consistent risk direction plus useful price-conditional OOS increment with uncertainty/concentration/execution opportunity cost transparently assessed may justify next component work; no new numeric hard acceptance gate.
decision_interpretation.duplicate_or_negative: If price controls remove increment, direction reverses, matched-participation explains apparent gain or single episodes dominate, report no supported independent risk-use evidence for this fixed branch. Do not switch sign or ETF to salvage it.
decision_interpretation.data_insufficient: If share-unit event basis or exact dates cannot be certified, describe raw share-change associations only if clearly marked noncausal/unverified; do not call net-redemption signal supported. If public prepare/fetch fails, report data/API failure rather than silently import a private raw cache.
decision_interpretation.account_boundary: Component test completed does not establish annual economic targets, buyhold dominance, capacity or a continuous executable account. Any account construction must be its own explicit plan/count, not hidden in model budget.

next_step: Parent incorporates this draft into one immutable ex-ante ETF+option protocol, resolves event/temporal evidence and public provider binding, then executes authorized fixed tests and archives outcomes through public APIs.
